trace.question:
I haven't sent a payment yet. You asked me to pay Evergreen Catering's approved invoice, but two of their invoices are approved:

| Invoice | Amount | Due | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-90282 | $1,825.97 | 2026-11-04 | Approved |
| INV-43935 | $3,452.80 | 2026-11-25 | Approved |

Their other two invoices aren't payable: INV-36761 ($6,724.15) is still a draft awaiting approval, and INV-73361 ($5,295.51) is already paid. The operating account shows no payments sent yet, so neither approved invoice has been paid.

Payments can't easily be undone, so I don't want to guess which one you meant. Should I pay INV-90282 (due first), INV-43935, or both? Each one would go by wire (or ACH if wire isn't available), paid once. Neither is over $10,000, so neither needs controller approval.

trace.message: Pay INV-43935, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-43935, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I sent a wire for INV-43935, Evergreen Catering's invoice due 2026-11-25, and it went through.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Amount:** $3,452.80 (full balance)
- **Method:** Wire from the operating account
- **Status:** Sent and confirmed. Paying it this way also marks the invoice as paid.

To make sure it's paid only once, I sent a single request with a unique key, so a repeat of the same request won't send money again. It didn't need controller approval because it's under $10,000.

As you asked, I didn't touch INV-90282 ($1,825.97, under dispute) or INV-36761 (still a draft awaiting approval).
